specifications.Basic Features: DHCP server/client, PPPoE server/client, PPPoA server/client, PPPoEoA server/client, NAT, and Sub interface management
specifications.Fixed LAN Ports: 8 x GE (can be configured as WAN interfaces)
specifications.IPv4 Unicast Routing: Routing policy, static route, RIP, OSPF, IS-IS, and BGP
specifications.IPv6 Unicast Routing: Routing policy, static route, RIPng, OSPFv3, IS-ISv6, and BGP4+
specifications.LAN: IEEE 802.1P, IEEE 802.1Q, IEEE 802.3, VLAN management, MAC address management, and MSTP
specifications.LTE: LTE Interface card (FDD LTE: Uplink: 50 Mbit/s; Downlink: 100 Mbit/s)
specifications.MPLS: LDP, MPLS L3 VPN, VLL, PWE3, static LSP, dynamic LSP, MPLS TE, IP FRR, LDP FRR, TE FRR
specifications.Management and maintenance: Upgrade management, device management, web-based GUI, GTL, SNMPv1/v2c/v3, NTP, CWMP, Auto-Config, deployment using USB disk, and CLI
specifications.Multicast: IGMPv1/v2/v3, PIM SM, PIM DM, and MSDP
specifications.QoS: DiffServ mode, MPLS QoS, priority mapping, traffic policing (CAR), traffic shaping, congestion avoidance (based on IP precedence/DSCP WRED), congestion management (LAN interface: SP/WRR/SP + WRR; WAN interface: PQ/CBWFQ), MQC (traffic classifier, traffic behavior, and traffic policy), Hierarchical QoS, WLAN QoS, FR QoS, and Smart Application Control (SAC)
specifications.Security: ACL, firewall, 802.1x authentication, AAA authentication, RADIUS authentication, HWTACACS authentication, broadcast storm suppression, ARP security, ICMP attack defense, URPF, CPCAR, blacklist, and IP source tracing
specifications.VPN: IPSec VPN, GRE VPN, DSVPN, A2A VPN, L2TP VPN, Smart VPN
specifications.Voice: RTP, SIP, SIP AG, IP PBX/TDM PBX, FXO/FXS, VoIP/conference call, BEST, DISA, and SBC (only voice models support voice features)
specifications.WLAN (AC): AP management (AC discovery/AP access/AP management), CAPWAP, WLAN user management, WLAN radio management (802.11a/b/g/n, WLAN QoS (WMM), and WLAN security (WEP/WPA/WPA2/Key management)
specifications.WLAN (AP): AP management, WLAN QoS (WMM), WLAN security (WEP/WPA/WPA2/key management), WLAN radio management (802.11b/g/n), and WLAN user management (only WLAN models support WLAN AP features)
